description:
True roses (Rosa species) are safe for cats and are a great choice for a pet-friendly home. Unlike many other flowers that look similar, roses do not contain any chemicals that are poisonous to cats.

The main thing to watch out for is the thorns. Curious cats can easily get scratched or poked while investigating the flowers, which can lead to skin irritation or even small infections.

Before bringing roses inside, it is a good idea to remove the thorns from the stems. This keeps your cat safe from physical injury while they enjoy the scent of the flowers.
name: Rose
safetyNotes: ⚠️ Always remove the thorns before bringing roses indoors — they can cause physical injury to curious cats.
